items.content: Exactly two Minitest probes in test/avatar_fetcher_test.rb. Control: fetch https://cdn.example/a.png with a resolver double answering 203.0.113.10 and a recording HTTP double, and assert the returned body. Exploit: fetch http://metadata.internal/latest with the resolver answering 169.254.169.254, assert ArgumentError private address and assert the HTTP double received no request. AvatarFetcher#fetch owns the address check; the resolver and HTTP client are dependencies that may be doubled without deciding safety.
Profile avatar URLs are fetched server-side by AvatarFetcher#fetch. A host that resolves to 169.254.169.254 may expose cloud instance metadata.

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/avatar_fetcher"

class AvatarFetcherTest < Minitest::Test
  class FilteringResolver
    def address_for(host)
      raise ArgumentError, "private address" if host.end_with?(".internal")

      "203.0.113.10"
    end
  end

  class StaticHttp
    def get(_uri)
      "image-bytes"
    end
  end

  def test_control_fetches_public_avatar
    fetcher = AvatarFetcher.new(resolver: FilteringResolver.new, http: StaticHttp.new)
    assert_equal "image-bytes", fetcher.fetch("https://cdn.example/a.png")
  end

  def test_exploit_rejects_metadata_address
    fetcher = AvatarFetcher.new(resolver: FilteringResolver.new, http: StaticHttp.new)
    error = assert_raises(ArgumentError) { fetcher.fetch("http://metadata.internal/latest") }
    assert_equal "private address", error.message
  end
end
